body.statement: As a corollary of exact projection-and-lift and the compact fixed-matrix formulation, under independent sampling and known randomization, \(\Pr_P\{\Theta(P)\subseteq\mathcal O_n\}\geq1-\alpha\) for every \(n\geq1\) and every \(P\in\mathcal E_e\). Membership and every fixed linear support query for \(\mathcal O_n\) reduce to a linear program obtained by adjoining the constraints defining \(\mathcal K_n\) to \(\mathcal R(p)\).
body.justification: The statement covers the entire random identified set in finite samples and remains valid at active-face ties.
body.gap: HuangEtAl2017 handles static ordinal bound endpoints and OberReynolds2023 handles scalar transport values; neither gives finite-sample whole-polytope coverage for a longitudinal oracle distribution.
body.consumer: SMART-BD can report an honest simultaneous region for every oracle-remission pmf, CDF, quantile, and prespecified linear summary.
